main_text.p: conflagranda subdedisse Neronem reos, & quæsitissimis pœnis affecisse, quos vulgus Christianos appellabat. Pereuntibus item adita ludibria, vt ferarum tergis contecti, laniatu canum interirent, aut crucibus affixi; aut flammandi, atque vbi defecisset dies in vsum nocturni luminis vrerentur. Quin & hortos suos ei spectaculo Nero obtulerat, tanquam non vtilitate publica, sed in saeuitiam vnius absumerentur.] Cùm interim Torpes & Euellius Aulici & Christiani, de ipsa Cæ-saris familia, non modò suas manus ab Imperatoris capite abstinuerint, sed sua etiam capita in manus Carnificum patienter tradiderint, & Ecclesia (licet grassante persecutione atrocissima) Iudici omnium Christo (vt inquit f Lib.7.c.5. {f}Oro-sius) pro inimicis & persecutoribus suis supplicarit.
Blank space remains below the text; no further printed text on this page.

page.notes: The opening quotation mark is printed at the start of every line of the quoted passage; only the first is retained. The square bracket "]" after "absumerentur." is printed in the text. The left margin note "f Lib.7.c.5." is the reference for the mark "f" in the text ("Oro-sius"). The page's text is set in roman type with italic names (Neronem, Christianos, Nero, Torpes, Euellius, Cæsaris, Oro-sius). The "CAP. II." below the text is set in small capitals and is treated as a catchword. The footnote entry above is a description, not printed text, and should be disregarded as printed content.
